notes.title: Steam Next Fest Announcement - Demo available now!
notes.content:
The new RunOut is here! During Steam Next Fest from February 24th to March 3rd, the RunOut - Hothead Paws demo will be available to download and play from our Steam Store page.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44389075/cbc3137a4a361bf7127ca64164cbcd248e3b3fc1.png

No more Run and Fun Together – the new RunOut - Hothead Paws is here!

Big Changes

 New Gameplay - Have the time of your life with friends and other players.
 New in-game events will make each match a fresh experience - Falling Box, Safe Zone, Pinata, Hardcore Punch, and Last Man Standing.
 New Camera Switch feature – Switch between 3rd-person view and full camera view during the match, as you need.
 Server/region selection: choose between US/EU/ASIA/HK

What you’ll find in this demo:

Meet the new RunOut - Hothead Paws, same friends, new game!


 Choose between 14 playable characters (6 of them to be unlocked), each with its own unique skills. Run through a dynamic stage, adapting to obstacles, traps, and random minigames!
 Fight your way against friends and foes in this chaotic, fun party game. 
 Collect coins by getting them through the map or just punch them away from your friends. Switch between the two camera modes to move precisely while keeping an eye on the dynamic level closing on you. 
 Steal the Spica Bear from your friends by hitting them with your unique skill or punches.
 Dance on their dropped coins for the ultimate BM.


We hope you have a lot of fun with this demo!

Find friends to play on our Discord server and follow us on our socials: X (Twitter) | Facebook | Instagram | YouTube | TikTok

notes.title: Devlog #2 - Even more Runners!
notes.content:
Hello Runners! 

Today we want to introduce you to even more characters that will be available in RunOut! Each character comes with unique skills, so you can always choose a runner that fits your mood and strategy.


Before we begin, make sure that you added RunOut to your Steam Wishlists!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2438120/RunOut__Run__Fun_Together/

All done? Now, let’s meet even more of our runners! 
[hr][/hr]
Pando
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44389075/6eeee43edd19a46efcd71fa8c6bcb823621e4b80.png
Meet Pando! This chill and loveable runner spent years training Kung Fu, so when the time comes, he’s able to punch his opponents so hard that they’re literally set on fire! Don’t mess with Pando and his flaming fist!  

Choose Pando if you want to show off your martial arts skills and beat your opponents both literally and figuratively.


Rinie
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44389075/afd397efe44ea34817a29aee0317a7ad6736ba00.png
Meet Rinie! When she wants to get to the finish line, you shouldn’t stand in her way. When she’s in a hurry, she can use her horn to send her competition flying, making the path to victory clean and empty!

Choose Rinie if you want to bump your opponents right into space!

Akito
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44389075/c572fa24eda6bbec0958a44ae9c53367a257b7f8.png
Meet Akito! This runner uses his voice as a weapon, and you’re not prepared to hear it! His howl is so loud that nearby runners just fall on the ground, while Akito makes his way to the finish line. A dog treat won’t help in this situation, so just get as far as possible if you think that Akito is preparing to howl! 

Choose Akito if you want to take your competition by surprise and clench the victory only by using your voice. 

[hr][/hr]

We hope you enjoyed learning more about the characters of RunOut. Who’s your favorite so far?
And that’s not all of them. In the next devlog, you’ll learn about more runners that will be available in RunOut! 

For now, join our Discord to meet other Runners like you, and be prepared to try the game when it's available!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44389075/eacd78a76f79c6d7ac4a937b9bfad22a908e516b.gif

notes.title: Devlog #1 - Meet the Runners
notes.content:
Hello Runners! 

In our first Devlog, we want to showcase some of the characters available in the game. Choosing your Runner is crucial - they all have different skills and stats. We wanted to add as much variety as possible to RunOut so every game will feel different when you change characters!

Before we begin, make sure that you added RunOut to your Steam Wishlists!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2438120/RunOut__Run__Fun_Together/

All done? Now, let’s meet our runners! 
[hr][/hr]
Croco
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44389075/3e5593eb7361b2816f7deaa94ec7b509afbb0612.jpg
Meet Croco. This crocodile may seem scary, but he’s actually very chill and friendly. He’s so friendly, in fact, that he can put you right into his mouth, but don’t worry, he won’t eat you - he’ll just help you get as far as you want! Or.. don’t want.

Choose Croco if you’re a team player who wants to help or if you want to spit out enemy players back to the start! 


Ottbee
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44389075/ccd6f56a375d0a17850fde6ad083350894b10d9b.jpg
Meet Ottbee! This fella is a perfect Runner for those who are just starting out. He’s very earnest and doesn’t try to win by using mischief. His skill is concentrating on increasing his speed and jumping power. His motto is to play smart, not hard! 

Choose Ottbee if you want to concentrate on winning without any funny business!  

Utangy
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44389075/0db511e6e16969bd0ec12971fa9cd8f48136e813.jpg
Meet Utangy! Now, that’s a different type of Runner. Is he even fast enough to be called a Runner? But Uttangy has an ace up his fur… His skill is to drop on the ground, break it, cause chaos, and jump forward very far! He might not be the fastest, but his jumps can let you outpace other players easily. He can be very powerful in the right hands or look pretty foolish in the wrong ones. 

Choose Utangy if you feel like jumping instead of running, and you won’t be disappointed! 


Cabpy
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44389075/23112ecf397a48406598a28f9636682c62879b76.jpg
Meet Cabpy! She’s unlike any other Runner because… she’s not alone! By using her skill, she calls on her children, who will make a giant wall on top of her back. First of all, no one wants to jump on top of cute capybaras. Second of all, if they try - they will explode! Carefully timed skill usage will easily let you explode players out of the game.

Choose Cabpy if you’re feeling particularly tricky and want to mess with other players!

Salmo
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44389075/d3e0da818a5134126dbb6d7f8e6dda46150827e6.jpg
Meet Salmo, he might not look like it, but he’s a fun-loving guy! His favorite trick is pulling out his fish sword and chasing other players. If you hit them enough times, they will faint, and you’ll have more time to win the race while they’re lying on the ground sleeping! 

Choose Salmo if you’re in a silly mood and want to hit other players instead of running!

[hr][/hr]

That’s it for our first devlog! We hope you liked learning about the characters and are even more excited to play RunOut! But these are not all of the characters we have in the game! In the coming weeks, we will continue telling you all about them! 

For now, join our Discord to meet other Runners like you and participate in the giveaway we’re holding until July 19! 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44389075/eacd78a76f79c6d7ac4a937b9bfad22a908e516b.gif

notes.title: Get ready for a run! Technical Playtest Test Coming Soon!
notes.content:
Hey Everyone!

Exciting news ahead! We're delighted to unveil the upcoming Technical Playtest Test for RunOut - Run & Fun Together. We've got a limited stash of 300 keys available. Missed it? No worries! Try your luck with the "Request Access" button on the Steam Page for a chance to be picked!

Get ready to put your skills to the test against each other through fun and challenging obstacles. With adorable animal characters of your choice, you'll be racing to be the first to collect the ultimate prize - the stuffed bear! 

(Requiring a minimum of 3 players to start a match in this version)

-------

The following are key areas of focus:

1. Game Server Testing: We will thoroughly test the game server for stability, load handling, and response times to ensure a smooth multiplayer experience.
2. Game Design Testing: We will evaluate the game design elements to ensure they're perfect for user experience, checking for balance, engagement, and overall fun factor.
3. Bug and Glitch Detection: We will take caution in identifying and documenting any bugs, glitches, or abnormalities within the game to quickly fix and improve.
4. Game Flow Testing: We will assess the game flow from start to finish, ensuring that all levels, transitions, and interactions are running and free of issues.

This is a Technical Playtest Test, we sincerely apologize for any issues acquired during the Technical Playtest Test since our game is still in the development phase. We will be improving sounds, visual effects, graphics, UI, Cloud Save, and more surprises.

We appreciate all the valuable feedback we can get from this Technical Playtest Test for further improvement to make the most enjoyable experience out of RunOut - Run & Fun Together.

Thank you.
WakaStudio Team
